verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a marketing-automation platform like Mailchimp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents version history, change review, or rollback for automations. Account export, webhooks, and AI analytics of automations are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
